benefit: Enter, stay in and transit through Montenegro without a Montenegrin visa
conditions: Stay no longer than the held visa's expiry if that is shorter than 30 days
notes: CONFLICT FLAGGED FOR COORDINATOR RE-CHECK: multiple secondary sources agree a new Regulation on the Visa Regime (Official Gazette No. 158/2026, applied from 1 Nov 2026, Article 5) also covers Australia, Japan, Canada and New Zealand visas/residence permits (30 days, same expiry cap), and that the APEC card dropped out. This researcher did NOT read the regulation text, so the wider list is NOT included; this entry follows the gov.me page actually read. Thailand appears in the country list on that page with an asterisk.
requires: A travel document with a valid Schengen visa, a valid US, UK or Ireland visa, or a residence permit from one of those countries

source.name: Government of Montenegro — Embassies and consulates of Montenegro and visa regimes for foreign citizens
